entries.meaning: ① 止痛药；镇痛药，指用于减轻疼痛的药物。
entries.en: The label on the painkiller bottle was too faded to read.
entries.zh: 止痛药瓶上的标签褪色得太厉害，已经看不清了。

entries.meaning:
① 过敏；变应性或变态反应，指免疫系统对某种物质产生的异常反应。
② 非正式比喻：对某人或某事的强烈反感、厌恶，常用 allergy to 表达。
entries.en: The registration form asks whether I have an allergy to latex.
entries.zh: 登记表询问我是否对乳胶过敏。

entries.meaning: ① 卫生纸；手纸，指如厕后清洁身体用的软纸，通常制成卷状。
entries.en: There's a spare roll of toilet paper in the cupboard under the sink.
entries.zh: 洗手池下方的柜子里有一卷备用卫生纸。

entries.meaning:
① 药店；药房，指出售或配发药品的商店、柜台或场所。
② 医院药房，指医院中配制、调配药品的部门。
③ 药学；药剂学，指研究药物配制与调配的学科，也可指这方面的技术、工作或专业。
entries.en: The new pharmacy stays open after the other shops on the street have closed.
entries.zh: 街上的其他商店关门后，那家新药店仍在营业。

entries.meaning: ① 吹风机；电吹风，指用气流（通常为热风）吹干头发的小型电器。
entries.en: The hotel keeps a hairdryer in a cloth bag beside the mirror.
entries.zh: 酒店把吹风机放在镜子旁的布袋里。

entries.meaning: ① 领取包裹；收件人到指定地点取走自己的快递包裹。这里指收件人取件，区别于快递员上门收取寄件人的待寄包裹。
entries.en: I'll pick up my parcel from the collection point after class.
entries.zh: 下课后，我会到取件点领取自己的包裹。

entries.term: request time off at short notice
entries.meaning: ① 临时请假；在距拟休假时间很短时才提出请假请求。这个表达不限定请假原因，也不表示申请已经获准。
entries.en: I had to request time off at short notice to deal with an urgent repair at home.
entries.zh: 为了处理家里的紧急维修，我不得不临时请假。

entries.term: my phone has run out of charge
entries.meaning: ① 我的手机没电了，指手机电池的电量已经耗尽；不表示手机损坏或无法修复。使用时可按说话对象和时态调整人称、时态。
entries.en: My phone ran out of charge while I was waiting for the bus.
entries.zh: 等公交车时，我的手机没电了。

heldWholeTuples.reason: The unqualified 制药业 tail can imply the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry. Consulted publisher entries establish preparation/dispensing science, art, practice/profession and dispensing places, but do not sufficiently establish that broad industry reading. Preserve this whole raw tuple in evidence, pending a different reader; do not prune it and call the remainder a retained whole tuple. New own definitions preserve all those independently established legitimate old roles.
